species: The NapAB and NrfA were also identified in protein extracts from both the C2H6- and C4H10-fed cultures (Supplementary Data 2 and 3, Fig. 2C), further supporting that populations E and B were performing DNRA in these systems.
sample_source: For protein extraction, enrichment cultures collected from Phase 1 and 2 (10 ml each phase) were pelleted by centrifugation (18 000 g, 4°C) and then washed with 1 × Phosphate buffered saline (PBS).
